name: Environmental Impacts of Digital Technologies
description: Impact'Num is a MOOC to question the environmental impacts of digital technologies, and learn how to measure, decipher, and act.
abstract: A 4-part MOOC combining awareness activities, educational videos, formative activities on indicators/data/trend analysis, and activities on possible individual and collective actions (as consumer, designer, teacher, citizen), co-produced by Association Class'Code and Inria.

audience.audienceType: Citizens, students, teachers wanting to understand and act on digital environmental impact

license: Not stated on the page (Free to access on FUN MOOC platform)
